Workflow.Name: PayPlus - Import Document Types
Workflow.Description: Imports PayPlus document types (GetDocumentTypes, he+en) into alex_payplus_documenttype. Triggered by alex_doc_import_enabled on the config row; env-aware (Production/Sandbox); writes back import status.
